title: Green Peppercorn Sauce
notes: This is a great and simple sauce to go with steak. It's also very versatile, choose a variation that suits your cut of meat and side dishes. You can make the demi-glace at home but the Soup Meister's demi is highly sought-after, not just by home cooks but also by restaurants both on the Shore and in Vancouver.

methodSections.heading: Green Peppercorn Sauce
steps: In a small saucepan or medium fry-pan at a medium to high heat, saute the shallots, garlic and peppercorns in the butter. Don't burn the shallots as this will add a bitter taste. Add the white wine and brandy and flambé.
Stir through the demi-glace and whipping cream and then simmer for 10 minutes. Blend using a stick mixer.

methodSections.heading: Variations
steps: 2 Cups Sliced mushrooms, sauté in a separate pan and add after the sauce is blended, allow to simmer in the sauce for a few minutes.
or... 1 Cup Sour pitted cherries, add after the sauce is blended, allow to simmer in the sauce for a few minutes.
or... 2 Tbsp Dijon, added with the demi-glace and whipping cream.
or... 1 Cup Port wine, added with the demi-glace and reduce a bit and then add the whipping cream.
